tasks.title: Implement database initialisation: open SQLite, enable WAL, create schema
tasks.description: Create src/db.ts. On module load: resolve DB_PATH = process.env.DATABASE_PATH ?? './data/checks.db', call fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(DB_PATH), { recursive: true }) to ensure the directory exists, open the database with new Database(DB_PATH), run db.pragma('journal_mode = WAL'), and execute CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS checks (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, url TEXT NOT NULL, status_code INTEGER, response_time_ms REAL NOT NULL, error TEXT, checked_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'))). No functions exported yet.
done_criteria: DATABASE_PATH env var is read with fallback to './data/checks.db'
fs.mkdirSync with recursive:true is called before Database() open
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS statement runs on import
tasks.commit_message_template: C4-TASK-1: implement SQLite database initialisation with WAL mode and schema creation

tasks.title: Implement and export insertCheck function
tasks.description: In src/db.ts, prepare a reusable INSERT statement at module load time: INSERT INTO checks (url, status_code, response_time_ms, error) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?). Export insertCheck(input: InsertCheckInput): CheckRow that runs the prepared statement, reads stmt.lastInsertRowid, fetches the full row by id, and returns it as a CheckRow. The function must correctly bind null for status_code and error when those fields are null.
done_criteria: INSERT prepared statement is created at module load (not inside the function body)
null values for status_code and error are correctly bound
Returned CheckRow includes auto-generated id and checked_at from the database
tasks.commit_message_template: C4-TASK-2: implement and export insertCheck function with prepared statement

tasks.title: Implement and export getAllChecks and getCheckById functions
tasks.description: In src/db.ts, prepare two reusable SELECT statements at module load time: 'SELECT * FROM checks ORDER BY checked_at DESC' and 'SELECT * FROM checks WHERE id = ?'. Export getAllChecks(): CheckRow[] that runs the first statement and returns all rows (empty array if none). Export getCheckById(id: number): CheckRow | null that runs the second statement and returns the row, or null if better-sqlite3 stmt.get() returns undefined.
done_criteria: getAllChecks is exported and returns CheckRow[]
SELECT prepared statements are created at module load
getAllChecks returns [] when table is empty (not null/undefined)
getCheckById returns null (not undefined) when not found
tasks.commit_message_template: C4-TASK-3: implement and export getAllChecks and getCheckById query functions
